key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize building energy management while making battery-control decisions understandable to operators.
engineering_relevance: By combining real-time measurements, forecasts, and dynamic prices, the framework helps reduce electricity costs and improve practical adoption of AI-based building control.
method: Trains on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for residential energy management.
Uses an expanded state space with PV output, demand, battery state, weather, price, calendar, and forecast signals.
Applies post-hoc explanation methods to interpret learned control policies.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates both synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus data, finding A2C and PPO outperform off-policy methods in cumulative reward and policy stability.
watch_item: Explainability is post-hoc, so the insights may not fully capture the agent's true internal reasoning or generalize across different building setups.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
